tswalu-reserve/loapi.intro: Six tented homes, each alone on the Kalahari with its own chef and butler.
tswalu-reserve/loapi.description:
Loapi is six tented homes spread far apart on the land at Tswalu, so you see no one unless you choose to. Each has canvas walls open to the Kalahari, a deep deck, a plunge pool, a fire pit and its own kitchen, with a chef and butler for your stay alone.

The camp runs on solar power with no light pollution, so the nights are dark and full of stars. Days are led by your own guide and vehicle: desert wildlife at first light, San rock art, and pangolin tracking with a conservationist.

tswalu-reserve/tarkuni.intro: A homestead taken whole, with five suites and your own team.
tswalu-reserve/tarkuni.description:
Tarkuni is a homestead at Tswalu taken by one family or group, with five en suite bedrooms for up to ten guests and no shared spaces. A chef, butler and guide look after you alone, with a plunge pool, a fire pit boma, a spa treatment room and wide indoor and outdoor living.

Each day is planned your way, with a private guide and vehicle: tracking pangolin, aardvark and cheetah, riding over the dunes, San rock art, stargazing from the deck or a night out at Malori.

lion-sands/river-lodge.description:
Lion Sands River Lodge sits along the Sabie River in the Sabi Sand Game Reserve, with eighteen rooms and suites for a personal safari surrounded by wilderness.

Watch the Big Five from your private deck, set out on guided bush walks and end the day at a boma dinner under the stars, with the river below the lodge.

lion-sands/hinkwenu-residence.intro: A two bedroom home at Tinga Lodge, taken whole, with its own pool and team.
lion-sands/hinkwenu-residence.description:
Hinkwenu Residence is an exclusive use home at Tinga Lodge on the Sabie River at Lion Sands, with two en suite bedrooms for up to six guests: four adults and two children. It has its own pool and deck, a covered veranda for meals and a living room under high thatch.

A villa concierge, chef, butler, housekeeper and an FGASA accredited field guide and tracker look after the house alone, with a private vehicle for two game drives a day. Children of all ages are welcome, with Mack & Madi activities and childminding included.
